name: Les Affluents du Numérique
postCreateCommand: git config --global --add safe.directory ${containerWorkspaceFolder} && git config --global core.filemode false && printf '.devcontainer/\n.pnpm-store/\n' > /home/node/.gitignore_global && git config --global core.excludesFile /home/node/.gitignore_global && sudo corepack disable pnpm && sudo npm install --global pnpm@10.33.0 && pnpm config set store-dir /home/node/.pnpm-store --global && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --force
